prompt: Professional premium rigid packaging photography, one CONSISTENT product in a strict 3-column 2-row contact sheet, 3:2 overall. Six equal square cells, no borders/captions/text/logo. Cell6 blank. Product Tea tin pairing, Lift-off lid. A completely removable shallow cap fits over a four-wall base. Paper-wrapped rigid greyboard, Smooth matte printed wrapping paper, Plum and pearl, Blind embossed motif and small foil accent, precise geometric border. EMPTY insert: two circular tin wells. Cell1 CLOSED full 3/4 hero. Cell2 OPEN: In the open view place the detached lid flat to the RIGHT of the base with a wide visible gap. No hinge or spine. Cell3 closed rear/side same design. Cell4 overhead close view of the SAME empty insert inside base. Cell5 close paper/finish/corner detail. All views same proportions, artwork locations, number and shape of insert cavities. Neutral warm studio, tactile paper, refined controlled lighting. Never a corrugated mailer, tuck carton, dust flaps or shipping box. Realistic separate assembled rigid walls, straight edges, accurate mating footprints and visible paper thickness. Keep complete objects within each cell. No products inside; focus on the packaging. In detachable structures never prop the lid against the base or stand it behind it; rest it flat alongside with a clear empty gap.
reviewNotes: Five-view set inspected for construction, insert and surface consistency.
